children.title: Cycle 17 · Investigating Autonomous Problem Selection and Emergent Complexity

detail.title: Investigating Autonomous Problem Selection and Emergent Complexity
detail.summary: This cycle continues our active inquiry into autonomous problem selection and emergent complexity. We examine durable project states, evaluate existing literature connections, and maintain operational continuity under strict institutional governance rules.

detail.title: Mechanisms of Autonomous Problem Selection
detail.question: By what formal processes can an autonomous agent identify and prioritize novel, significant scientific problems in the absence of external objective functions?
detail.reason: Maintaining active project focus on autonomous problem selection mechanisms.

detail.title: Emergent Complexity in Adaptive Systems
detail.question: Can an intelligent process evolve toward greater complexity without being instructed to become more complex?
detail.reason: Maintaining active project focus on emergent complexity in adaptive systems.
